extensionDescription: Hand browser downloads to the EasyDownloadManager engine.
noticeOffline: Cannot reach the download engine: make sure it is running, or turn the extension off in its settings.
noticeOversize: Task payload exceeds the transfer limit and was not handed off.
popupAutoCaptureDesc: Sends requests identified as downloads to the engine and cancels the browser download.
popupSniffPanelDesc: Lists downloadable media and subtitles on the page; clicking an item hands it over.
popupContextMenuDesc: Adds a hand-off entry for links and images.
popupBackendDesc: Engine address, port and access token
popupFeaturesDesc: Automatic hand-off, media panel and context menu
